lines.beaver_en: What have you been thinking about lately?

lines.en: It's "Without dreams, you're a living corpse."

lines.beaver_en: A bit scary, but that's a good saying.
lines.en: I learned it from Mr. Park Jeongmin in high school.

lines.beaver_en: What kind of teacher was he?
lines.en: It was a fateful meeting. He was a philosophical man.

lines.beaver_en: Have you lived by those words?
lines.learner: 네, 덕분에 끝까지 버텨 내서 시험에 합격했어요.
lines.en: Yes, thanks to it, I held on to the end and passed the exam.
lines.roman: ne, deokbune kkeutkkaji beotyeo naeseo siheome hapgyeokaesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: You must have felt a great sense of achievement.
lines.en: Yes, the achievement felt as big as my effort.

lines.beaver_en: But don't you get tired chasing only success?
lines.en: On the other hand, I also pursue joy and romance.

lines.beaver_en: Is it okay to do anything for success?
lines.learner: 아니요, 부도덕한 성공은 성공이 아니라고 봐요.
lines.en: No, I don't think immoral success counts as success.
lines.roman: aniyo, budodeokan seonggongeun seonggongi anirago bwayo.

lines.beaver_en: Then what do you value most?
lines.en: I think human life is the most precious.

lines.beaver_en: I really enjoyed our talk today.
lines.en: I learned a lot thanks to you. Thank you.
